rt_open_the_cistern.name: Open the Cistern
rt_open_the_cistern.description: Pour the cistern on the target tile (range 2-4) and the four tiles around it: they become tide shallows for 4 turns.

rt_wading_rite.name: Wading Rite
rt_wading_rite.description: Passive: adjacent allies gain +1 defense, standing in the spill.

rt_r3_overflow.name: Overflow
rt_r3_overflow.description: Turn tiles within 2 of the target tile (range 2-5) into tide shallows for 4 turns. Enemies there take 3 flat brine damage and are Soaked for 2 turns.

rt_drinker_slap.name: Sodden Slap
rt_drinker_slap.description: Deal attack brine damage to an adjacent enemy.

rt_brine_burst.name: Burst
rt_brine_burst.description: Deal 7 flat brine damage to all adjacent enemies and apply Soaked for 2 turns. The Salt-Drinker dies.

rt_r3_spit_it_back.name: Spit It Back
rt_r3_spit_it_back.description: Deal 4 flat brine damage at range 2-3 and apply Soaked for 2 turns.

rt_harrowgate_rod.name: Deacon's Rod
rt_harrowgate_rod.description: Deal attack brine damage to an adjacent enemy.

rt_wring_the_doubter.name: Wring the Doubter
rt_wring_the_doubter.description: Drain 5 flat brine damage from any unit within 1-2, ally or enemy, and heal the Deacon for 5.

rt_congregation.name: Congregation
rt_congregation.description: Passive: Harrowgate gains +1 attack for each adjacent ally, up to +3.

rt_harrowgate_sermon.name: Sermon of Doubt
rt_harrowgate_sermon.description: Deal 2 flat brine damage to enemies within 1 and apply Soaked for 2 turns and Wrung for 2 turns.

rt_legend_baptism.name: Baptism
rt_legend_baptism.description: Legend. Deal attack+3 brine damage to an adjacent enemy and apply Soaked for 2 turns. If it dies to this blow (not a hero or Beacon), it rises as your Drowned on its tile.

sc_inquisitor_censer.name: Censer Rap
sc_inquisitor_censer.description: Deal attack physical damage at range 1-2.

sc_censure.name: Censure
sc_censure.description: Deal attack-1 salt damage at range 2-3 and Silence the target for 2 turns (-2 attack, -2 AP). Deals 3 extra damage if the target is Soaked.

sc_dry_the_heretic.name: Dry the Heretic
sc_dry_the_heretic.description: Salt-crust the tiles within 1 of the target tile (range 2-4) for 3 turns, ending any pool or shallows there. Enemies in the area take 3 flat salt damage, or 6 if Soaked.

sc_r3_dry_sermon.name: Dry Sermon
sc_r3_dry_sermon.description: Silence every enemy within 2 for 2 turns and deal 2 flat salt damage to them.

sc_sapper_pick.name: Sapper's Pick
sc_sapper_pick.description: Deal attack physical damage to an adjacent enemy.

sc_charge_the_seam.name: Charge the Seam
sc_charge_the_seam.description: Blow the tile at range 1-3 to rubble (dead coral), breaking any wall or obstacle standing there.

sc_fuse.name: Fuse
sc_fuse.description: Light a salt charge on the target tile (range 2-4). It bursts at once: enemies within 1 take 4 flat salt damage and are Caustic for 2 turns.

sc_r3_second_charge.name: Second Charge
sc_r3_second_charge.description: Deal 6 flat salt damage to enemies within 1 of the target tile (range 2-4) and apply Caustic for 3 turns. The tile becomes rubble.

sc_lancer_pike.name: Verge Pike
sc_lancer_pike.description: Deal attack physical damage to an adjacent enemy.

sc_verge_charge.name: Verge Charge
sc_verge_charge.description: Gallop to an empty tile up to 3 away.

sc_couched_lance.name: Couched Lance
sc_couched_lance.description: Deal attack+4 physical damage and push the target 1 tile (collision deals 2 extra). Slow to turn: the Lancer is Winded (-1 AP) for 1 turn after.

sc_r3_levelled_lance.name: Levelled Lance
sc_r3_levelled_lance.description: Deal attack+6 physical damage and push the target 2 tiles (collision deals 3 extra). The Lancer is not Winded.

sc_pryce_theodolite.name: Brass Theodolite
sc_pryce_theodolite.description: Deal attack physical damage at range 1-2.

sc_pryce_triangulate.name: Triangulate
sc_pryce_triangulate.description: Deal attack-1 physical damage to every enemy in a line of 6 and apply Marked for 2 turns.

sc_pryce_survey_holds.name: The Survey Holds
sc_pryce_survey_holds.description: Passive: Pryce and adjacent allies gain +1 AP. The map is true, so go further.

sc_pryce_plumb_line.name: Plumb Line
sc_pryce_plumb_line.description: Deal attack+1 salt damage at range 2-5 and apply Caustic for 2 turns.

sc_legend_last_measurement.name: The Last Measurement
sc_legend_last_measurement.description: Legend. Swap places with any allied unit within 1-8, setting the line where it is needed.

sv_diver_wrench.name: Diver's Wrench
sv_diver_wrench.description: Deal attack physical damage to an adjacent enemy.

sv_lead_boots.name: Lead Boots
sv_lead_boots.description: Passive: +1 defense. Nothing shifts a diver in lead boots.

sv_crowbar.name: Crowbar
sv_crowbar.description: Deal attack physical damage to an enemy within 2-3, pull it 1 tile and Root it for 1 turn.

sv_r3_dead_weight.name: Dead Weight
sv_r3_dead_weight.description: Gain Shielded for 2 turns and deal attack physical damage to all adjacent enemies, rooting them for 1 turn.

sv_broker_cane.name: Broker's Cane
sv_broker_cane.description: Deal attack physical damage to an adjacent enemy.

sv_fence_it.name: Fence It
sv_fence_it.description: Sell something that was never the Broker's to sell: gain 8 Tide.

sv_bad_debt.name: Bad Debt
sv_bad_debt.description: Apply In Debt to an enemy within 1-3 for 2 turns (-1 attack, -1 AP) and gain 3 Tide.

sv_r3_double_books.name: Double the Books
sv_r3_double_books.description: Gain 6 Tide and apply Shielded to yourself for 1 turn.

sv_render_scoop.name: Render Scoop
sv_render_scoop.description: Deal attack physical damage to an adjacent enemy.

sv_hot_ladle.name: Hot Ladle
sv_hot_ladle.description: Deal attack fire damage at range 1-2 and apply Burning for 2 turns.

sv_grease_the_deck.name: Grease the Deck
sv_grease_the_deck.description: Pour lamp oil under an adjacent enemy: its tile becomes lamp oil for 3 turns.

sv_r3_flash_boil.name: Flash Boil
sv_r3_flash_boil.description: Deal 3 flat fire damage to enemies within 1 of the target tile (range 2-4), apply Burning for 2 turns and spill lamp oil there for 2 turns.

sv_hesk_quill.name: Quill Knife
sv_hesk_quill.description: Deal attack physical damage to an adjacent enemy.

sv_hesk_forged_orders.name: Forged Orders
sv_hesk_forged_orders.description: Deliver a counterfeit command to an enemy within 1-3: it loses its next turn (Stunned for 1 turn).

sv_hesk_paper_trail.name: Paper Trail
sv_hesk_paper_trail.description: Swap places with any unit within 1-4.

sv_hesk_short_change.name: Short Change
sv_hesk_short_change.description: Deal attack-1 physical damage to an enemy within 1-3 and drain 4 Tide from the enemy.

sv_legend_thirty_knives.name: Thirty Knives
sv_legend_thirty_knives.description: Legend. Call two Scrappers onto or near the target tile (range 1-3), each holding a knife that was not there a moment ago.
